notes.title: Update 7/13/2023 - Conundrum Catacombs Version Production 0.1.3
notes.content:
Added the following:

Monster which chases the player and has a patrol path

Notes that are interactive and can be activated to provide story information

Decorations in the form of skeletons, some bloody some not, to add to the immersion

Heartbeat sounds when the player has a lower torch level

Sounds for the monster

Ambiance audio loop

Changed the following:

The turkey leg is no longer a pick up and now is an item which can be picked up and used whenever you need a speed boost

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Getting my INDIE GAME on STEAM with only $150
notes.content:
[h1] Devlog #3 for Conundrum Catacombs [/h1]

"Great news! We've just uploaded Conundrum Catacombs to Steam, and we're excited to share our journey with you. Check out our latest devlog now live on YouTube, where we walk you through the process of publishing our game on Steam. Join us on this exciting adventure and be sure to add Conundrum Catacombs to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on our progress!"
